title: Testing Pyramid
description: Understand the different levels of testing and their purposes.

data.text: The **Testing Pyramid** describes the optimal distribution of tests across different levels: many unit tests, fewer integration tests, and even fewer end-to-end tests.

items: Unit Tests – Fast, isolated, test single units
E2E Tests – Test complete user flows

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Most tests should be unit tests
E2E tests are slow but valuable
data.takeaway: Follow the testing pyramid for an efficient test suite.
